recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core. Future changes to ChargeItemDefinition.account should be made in HL7/admin-incubator, not by reintroducing ChargeItemDefinition artifacts into the FHIR core checkout.
issue_request: FHIR-42818 was an Applied PA change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking to add ChargeItemDefinition.account 0..* Reference(Account) with candidate-account definition and guidance that the intended accounts are cost-center-style accounts rather than patient-oriented accounts.
initial_application: Core commit bbea8fb1ff0ed54bd9f87ca6db401e2e21328d15 implemented the Jira request by adding ChargeItemDefinition.account to source/chargeitemdefinition/structuredefinition-ChargeItemDefinition.xml and adding the ChargeItemDefinition-account reference search parameter to source/chargeitemdefinition/bundle-ChargeItemDefinition-search-params.xml.
additional_context: The current core checkout has no active ChargeItemDefinition resource in source/fhir.ini and no source/chargeitemdefinition directory. Later commit 71567db3ee039ac6977be5f96a7e013896569a36 removed ChargeItemDefinition and other immature resources from core and updated ballot/narrative pages to point ChargeItemDefinition at the HL7 Admin Incubator IG. The current HL7/admin-incubator source contains ChargeItemDefinition.account with Reference(Account) and the account search parameter.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No core source change was made because ChargeItemDefinition is no longer in current core build scope and the external repository that now owns it already carries the requested element.
